name: ReconFusion
definition: A method to reconstruct real-world scenes using only a few photos by leveraging a diffusion prior for novel view synthesis to regularize a NeRF-based 3D reconstruction pipeline at novel camera poses.
summary: ReconFusion is a 3D reconstruction method that recovers high-quality scenes from few input images by regularizing NeRF optimization with a multiview-conditioned diffusion prior trained for novel view synthesis.
